home.heroSub: Rooms, Moroccan bath spa, restaurant and bar in Jemo 1, Addis Ababa. Rated 4.7 on Google. Book instantly on WhatsApp.
home.intro: Yehin Shado Hotel is a hospitality house with fully furnished rooms, a signature spa, traditional and international dining, and a lively bar — all on the 3rd floor next to Saba Building. Front desk is always open. Booking is personal: message us on WhatsApp and we take care of the rest.

services.roomsDesc: Standard single and double rooms with private layouts, clean bedding and daily housekeeping.
services.spaDesc: Moroccan bath, sauna, steam and massage — private wellness sessions in a calm, hygienic setting.
services.diningDesc: Ethiopian classics and international plates, with a bar for beers, wines and cocktails.

home.spaHighlightBody: Our Maghrebi hammam is the heart of the spa: warm steam, traditional ritual and skilled therapists. Book a private session for deep rest after travel or a long Addis day.
home.reelsSub: Vertical tours of our rooms, spa, dining and bar.

testimonials.oneQuote: The Moroccan bath was unforgettable — private, clean and truly relaxing. I left lighter than I arrived.
testimonials.twoQuote: Quiet, well-kept rooms and a 24/7 desk that actually answers. Perfect for a business overnight in Jemo.
testimonials.threeQuote: Tibs, injera and a properly stocked bar. We came for dinner and stayed for another round.

home.locationBody: Next to Saba Building, 3rd Floor, Addis Ababa. Front desk is open around the clock.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to relax? Book on WhatsApp now.
home.ctaSub: Rooms, spa treatments and tables — we reply quickly.

rooms.heroSub: Fully furnished standard singles and doubles for couples, business travelers and solo guests.
rooms.intro: Every room is fully furnished with a private layout, flat-screen TV, free Wi-Fi and daily housekeeping. Check in any hour — our front desk never closes. Share your dates on WhatsApp and we will confirm availability and rates.
rooms.singleDesc: A calm private room for solo travelers and short business stays, with clean bedding and everything you need for a quiet night.
rooms.doubleDesc: A comfortable double for couples or companions, with a private layout and space to unwind after a day in Addis.
rooms.videoBody: See the layout, light and finishes before you message us. Availability is confirmed in chat — no online booking engine.

faq.q1: How do I book a room?
faq.a1: Tap Book Now and send us your dates on WhatsApp. We reply with availability and rates. There is no online payment form.
faq.q2: What room types do you have?
faq.a2: Fully furnished Standard Single and Standard Double rooms.
faq.q3: Is the front desk always open?
faq.a3: Yes. Reception is staffed 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
faq.a4: Yes. Complimentary Wi-Fi is included in every stay.

rooms.ctaSub: Tell us single or double, and your check-in date.

spa.heroSub: Yehin Shado's signature wellness center — Moroccan bath, sauna, steam and therapeutic massage.
spa.intro: Step out of the city into warmth and quiet. Sessions are private, hygienic and led by trained therapists using traditional Maghrebi and contemporary techniques.
spa.moroccanDesc: A full hammam ritual of steam, cleansing and restoration. Our signature experience.
spa.moroccanBenefit: Deeply cleanses, eases travel fatigue and resets the senses.
spa.saunaDesc: Dry heat to loosen tight muscles and support circulation after a long day.
spa.saunaBenefit: Relieves stiffness and helps you sleep more deeply.
spa.steamDesc: Gentle steam that opens the breath and softens the skin.
spa.steamBenefit: Calms the body and prepares you for massage or hammam.
spa.massageDesc: Choose relaxation, deep-tissue or aromatherapy with certified masseuses.
spa.massageBenefit: Releases tension and leaves you grounded and clear.
spa.videoBody: Watch a vertical tour of the Moroccan bath and spa rooms, then reserve a private time on WhatsApp.

faq.q1: Do I need to book in advance?
faq.a1: Yes. Message us on WhatsApp so we can hold a private session and confirm the treatment you want.
faq.a2: A Maghrebi hammam: steam, traditional cleansing and unhurried care in a private room.
faq.a3: Our masseuses are trained and sessions follow hygienic, private-room practice.
faq.a4: Yes. Ask for hammam plus massage, or sauna and steam, when you write to us.

spa.ctaSub: Moroccan bath, sauna, steam or massage — tell us what you need.
